description: Assigns deterministic, file-path-independent identifiers to graph nodes. SHA-256 of kind + name + normalised signature. File and module nodes include filePath to prevent collision between same-named files in different directories. Powers temporal diffing and cross-machine annotation resolution.
label: Semantic Identity

members.note: Entry point. Special-cases file/module kinds to include filePath.
Strips default parameter values and collapses whitespace before hashing.
Reverse map from semantic IDs back to CodeGraph IDs. Target overwrites base — current codebase takes priority.
